scope: Original 2020 base/core standard 2–4-player including required two-player House Hagal. Excludes solo, variants and expansions.

questions.question: How is the Conflict Deck built, top to bottom, and what happens to unused Conflict cards?
What are each human player’s starting Agents, troops, water, Influence and VP in three- versus four-player play?
May you Reveal while you still have Agents, and can you take another Agent turn or play a Plot Intrigue later in this phase after that Reveal turn?
What does a legal ordinary Agent turn require regarding card, icons, number of Agents, occupancy, costs and when those costs are paid?
Can an Agent card’s gain of spice pay Conspire’s entry cost when you have only 3 spice? Once legally placed, in what order may card, space and Faction Influence effects resolve?

At a Combat space you recruit 2 troops from its effect and 1 from your card and already have 4 garrisoned. What is the maximum deployment, where do undeployed recruits go, and can Rally Troops normally deploy its recruits?
List the Reveal turn steps in order, whose Reveal boxes are used, and where all played cards go at cleanup.
During your Reveal turn may you buy the replacement for a card you just acquired, combine/split Persuasion, save leftovers, or use the acquired card immediately? When does an Acquire effect happen?
What is strength with 3 troops in the Conflict and 4 revealed swords? What if your last deployed troop is removed, and how are strength values over 20 tracked?
Who can play Combat Intrigue, in what order, does a pass bind later turns, when does combat resolve, and when are “when you win” cards played?
In four-player combat A and B tie for first and C beats D: who wins and what rewards are available? What do ties for second or third yield, what about 0 strength, and where do troops go afterwards?
When are Maker bonus spice and normal harvesting resolved, which spaces use them, and what happens if an Agent has moved away before Makers?

When does the game end if someone reaches 10 VP mid-round or the last Conflict is revealed? What resolves before the winner, and what is the complete tiebreak order including the FAQ’s final fallback?
What happens to the VP at 2 Influence and bonus at 4 if you later drop below them and return? How is an Alliance first gained or taken from a tied holder by advancing?
You hold an Alliance tied at 5 Influence with two opponents, then lose 1 Influence. Who gets it? What if instead you are the only player at 4 and fall to 3?
How do trashing and discarding differ in destination and eligible cards, including Reserve cards? Is trashing always optional, and may you reshuffle an empty deck merely to inspect its top card?
How does control of Arrakeen, Carthag or Imperial Basin pay out on any player’s visit, on winning a new control reward, and when a matching Conflict is revealed later?
Describe complete two-player House Hagal setup, when it takes turns, how many Agents it has, and whether it Reveals, earns VP/resources/rewards or can hold an Alliance.

For a two-player Rival Agent turn, what happens to occupied-space cards, empty deck/Reshuffle, space costs/effects, recruitment, deployment and Harvest Spice bonus? What if a two-space card’s applicable option is occupied?

In two-player Combat how does House Hagal get strength and handle rewards/control, including if it wins a space you control? Do human second-place ties pay the third reward even though ordinary third place is unavailable?
